Guildford is sub-area F27 of North Surrey in Paragon, the MLS® board system. The listings above are limited to townhouses in Guildford, with apartments, detached homes and duplexes left out. Underneath, you'll see how the Guildford Plan bears on a townhome, how the bus connects you to SkyTrain, and what to read in a strata package here.

Guildford lies between City Centre to the west and Fraser Heights to the east. Its hub is Guildford Exchange, and Guildford Library sits inside the Guildford Recreation Centre on 105 Avenue. Townhome complexes appear both near that core and on the residential blocks around it, so you can choose between a short walk to the bus and a street with less traffic.

blocks.text: What the Guildford Plan means for townhome buyers

parts.t: The Guildford Plan is the Council-approved City of Surrey strategy for how this area grows. Its boundary runs from 140 Street east to the Highway 1 interchange at 160 Street, and it covers Guildford Centre plus the Hawthorne and Headwaters districts.

A townhome complex is usually lower than what the plan allows around it. That cuts both ways. A designation for taller buildings next door can change the light, parking and traffic on your street. The same plan also guides where the City puts public amenities, parks and infrastructure, so it can point to improvements close to a complex you like. Reading the map is part of checking any address here.

There's no SkyTrain station in Guildford itself. The R1 King George Blvd RapidBus leaves Guildford Exchange, runs west on 104 Avenue to Surrey Central Station, then continues south to King George Station and Newton Exchange. RapidBus stops less often than a local route, which helps on longer trips. If a train at your door matters most, my
Whalley condos for sale
page shows homes near the Expo Line.
Most Guildford townhomes are strata lots. You own your unit, and together with the other owners you own the common property through the strata corporation.

Start with the strata plan. In a conventional plan, each lot is defined by the walls, floors and ceilings of the building. In a bare land plan, lot lines come from survey markers, and common property is often just roads, services and shared facilities. The split decides who pays for a roof or a fence.

Ask the strata for a Form B, which it must supply within 7 days. Check the monthly fee, any special levies already approved and the contingency reserve fund balance, then read the budget to see what that fee pays for.

A strata of five or more lots needs a depreciation report on a five-year cycle, projecting repair and replacement costs for its common assets over 30 years. Look for when the roofs, siding and paving are next due.
The Standard Bylaws apply unless the complex filed its own at the Land Title Office. Get the full filed set and current rules, and check pet limits and any limits on changing a yard or patio.

1. Where in Guildford are the townhome complexes?
They're spread across the sub-area, with many close to Guildford Exchange and the 104 Avenue corridor and others on quieter residential streets nearby.
2. How does the Guildford Plan affect a townhome purchase?
The plan's land use map shows what each nearby lot is designated for. A complex next to a lot marked for higher density could see new buildings beside it.
3. Which bus links Guildford townhomes to SkyTrain?
The R1 King George Blvd RapidBus starts at Guildford Exchange and travels along 104 Avenue to Surrey Central Station.
4. Is a Guildford townhome always strata-titled?
Usually, but confirm it. Pull the title and the strata plan to see whether the unit is a strata lot and whether the plan is conventional or bare land.
5. What repairs does a Guildford strata usually handle?
In a conventional strata under the Standard Bylaws, the strata corporation looks after the building's structure and exterior, outside doors and windows, and fences around yards.
6. What should I compare between two Guildford complexes?
Compare each one's Form B, budget, depreciation report, recent minutes and filed bylaws. Fees, reserve funds and upcoming work can differ a lot between neighbours.
7. Does this page include Guildford condos or houses?
No. It lists Guildford townhouses only. Apartments have their own Guildford condos page, and every home type appears on my Guildford homes page.
